brief: After the Rain — English female vocal EDM. 150 seconds, approximately 126 BPM, 4/4. Four-on-the-floor kick, sidechain-style pulsing bass/pads, arpeggiated synth and bright melodic lead. Sung verse, emotional pre-chorus, chorus/build, instrumental melodic drop, breakdown and returning final drop. Hook: “After the rain, we come alive / Your hand in mine, electric skies”. The drop should develop the song’s musical identity. Keep intelligible lyrics away from the busiest passages.

lyrics.text:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Gutters drip along the street
Puddles shine beneath our feet
Your collar's wet, your laugh is loud
The moon breaks through a broken cloud

[Pre-Chorus]
Thunder fades and I can breathe
Hold me close, don't let it leave

[Chorus]
After the rain, we come alive
Your hand in mine, electric skies
Puddles hold the streetlamp's light
We're awake inside the night

[Drop]

[Breakdown]
I counted seconds between the cracks
Now I'm counting your heartbeat back
Lift your face, let the light pour in
We're starting over, let it begin

[Chorus]
After the rain, we come alive
Your hand in mine, electric skies
Puddles hold the streetlamp's light
We're awake inside the night

[Drop]

[Outro]
